---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
author: "Isabella Chandler"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "data/seda_2025.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
score_change <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  group_by(district_id, district_name, state) |>
  summarise(
    score_2015 = max(if_else(year == 2015, rla_score, NA_real_)),
    score_2023 = max(if_else(year == 2023, rla_score, NA_real_)),
    n_years = n_distinct(year),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_years == 2) |>
  mutate(score_change = score_2023 - score_2015) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, score_change) |>
  collect()

state_change <- tbl(con, "state_scores") |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  group_by(stateabb, state_name) |>
  summarise(
    score_2015 = max(if_else(year == 2015, rla_score, NA_real_)),
    score_2023 = max(if_else(year == 2023, rla_score, NA_real_)),
    n_years = n_distinct(year),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_years == 2) |>
  mutate(score_change = score_2023 - score_2015) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, score_2015, score_2023, score_change) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| fig-format: png
score_change_plot <- score_change |>
  mutate(
    rla_change = score_change,
    change_direction = case_when(
      rla_change > 0 ~ "Positive",
      rla_change < 0 ~ "Negative",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  )

score_change_histogram <- ggplot(score_change_plot, aes(x = rla_change, fill = change_direction)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of District Reading Score Changes",
    subtitle = paste("Districts with scores in both years:", nrow(score_change_plot)),
    x = "Reading score change (2015 to 2023)",
    y = "Number of districts",
    fill = "Change",
    caption = "Positive values indicate improvement; negative values indicate decline."
  )

ggsave("score_change.png", plot = score_change_histogram, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
score_change_histogram
```

```{r}
state_change_plot <- state_change |>
  mutate(
    change_direction = case_when(
      score_change > 0 ~ "Positive",
      score_change < 0 ~ "Negative",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    ),
    state_name = fct_reorder(state_name, score_2023)
  )

state_change_arrow_chart <- ggplot(state_change_plot, aes(y = state_name)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = score_2015, xend = score_2023, yend = state_name, color = change_direction),
    arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.12, "inches"))
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = score_2015), color = "gray60") +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Scores: 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = "States are ordered by their 2023 reading score",
    x = "Reading score",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Change",
    caption = "Gray dots mark 2015 scores; arrows point to 2023 scores and are colored by direction of change."
  )

ggsave("state_change.png", plot = state_change_arrow_chart, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)
state_change_arrow_chart
```
